description.narrative: The activity was planned by YAT and SLYP together after realising the negative effects that Covid 19 brought to the project whereby SLYP failed to visit Zimbabwe due to the travelling restrictions. The network activity was therefore suggested as the most possible way for SLYP to get the same appreciation in the partnership project through a visit to Zimbabwe and conducting of a joint feedback, evaluation and future project planning workshop. The idea of conducting the network activity was initially discussed between YAT and SLYP at a DUF -YETT organised conference in Victoria Falls (1st -5th November 2021). It was taken up virtually in January 2022 through a whatsapp group call where the final discussion was deliberated upon in the presence of both YAT and SLYP representatives and the group agreed to formulate an application. YAT was tasked to prepare the application and send it to SLYP for review and additions before sending it to DUF.
